notes: This graph is a machine-readable routing index, not theory authority.
Do not invent missing branches from filenames, worker names, or recurrence labels.
A worker change, method change, repository move, or bounded step does not by itself create a new branch.
Populate progressively from verified durable branch/task state; unknown fields remain explicit.

Excavation remains supporting infrastructure. Confidence attaches first to faithful representation/reproduction of accepted physics; it does not automatically transfer to SAT/H(s)H derivation, novelty, or validation.

branches.title: Geometric solver vs standard-equation side-by-side pipeline
branches.intent: Build an auditable Python-capable comparison harness for matched SAT/H(s)H geometric-solver and standard/reference-equation cases without hiding target leakage, fit freedom, units, transformations, or representation assumptions.
exposure_constraints: Do not treat numerical agreement as derivation or validation
dependencies: Recover or preserve candidate status of the exact Hagalaz operator
Use one declared shared material/director gauge before comparing translation residuals
Inject cross-solver disturbances at the shared primitive 4D data level before deriving either representation
Treat the first Hagalaz ↔ Three-Spheres benchmark as complementary-channel unless a genuinely homologous Hagalaz geometric-admissibility observable is recovered
Keep Three-Spheres symmetry defect, carrier viability, and numerical reconstruction certification as separate typed channels
branches.last_material_state: ACTIVE EDGE THROUGH RUN 085: Runs 081-082 classified the first Hagalaz ↔ Three-Spheres benchmark as complementary-channel and ran the first shared-primitive numerical control. Runs 083-084 separated pair-distance spread from carrier viability and generalized the carrier margin to arbitrary non-collinear equal-S3 centers, G_carrier = 1-r_c^2/R^2. Run 085 converted the degenerate-center caveat into a two-axis status contract: geometric carrier state is reportable only with separately certified numerical reconstruction; numerical degradation/singularity must return geometry unresolved rather than masquerading as carrier collapse. Adversarial controls show both directions: collapse can occur with a regular solve, and conditioning policy can fire while a real carrier exists. Exact Hagalaz source remains unrecovered and candidate status is unchanged.
branches.next_cursor: Implement the Run-085 typed carrier/numerical status contract in the actual non-quarantined Three-Spheres solver/control code and regression-test the standard equilateral collapse plus both Run-085 adversarial controls. Incorporate the already-routed generic-offset two-crossing fixture as a regression only if it exercises the same live detector; do not continue accumulating one-parameter circumcircle examples. After implementation/regression, return to the broader Whirligig/UI/Hagalaz comparator with the typed carrier channel treated as a finished component unless the implementation exposes a concrete defect.
branches.exit_criterion: One paired case runs through both sides from a shared manifest with reproducible metadata and an auditable comparison report.
